title: どんぐりころころ (Donguri Korokoro — The Rolling Acorn)
description: A delightful Taisho-era children's song about a round acorn that rolls into a pond. A friendly loach fish invites it to play, and they have a wonderful time together — but then the little acorn misses its mountain and starts to cry, leaving the loach in a muddle. The story teaches children about homesickness and the kindness of friendship.
